sections.title: Improved
items: Profile now uses Sign out and offers Continue with Apple or Continue with Google when you are using Naturebook without a linked account.
App Store purchase access is secured before sign-out and verified on the fresh local account, while account-issued beta or promotional access remains with the linked account.

entries.title: Scans stay safe when connection drops

sections.title: Fixed
items: If Wi-Fi appears connected but cannot reach the internet, or a connection drops or silently stalls while live Insight is open, an eligible scan is saved within a short safety window and resumes automatically instead of showing a Network timeout result.
Online scan recovery now keeps the status focused on identification and removes the redundant saved/continuing explanation; offline recovery still shows when a scan is waiting for connection.
Instant single-photo scans now move directly into automatic submission without briefly showing the manual Identify tray when confirmation is disabled.

Photo imports now check scan availability before selection and cropping, then open crop directly without flashing staged controls or adding a separate black handoff layer; crop actions stay clear of the status area and the confirmation action remains readable.

sections.title: New
items: Events are now available to everyone, with curated, non-competitive Field trip goals, explicit Join, event progress, completion badges, and published entry pages.
Eligible event hashtags can appear as optional Explore sharing suggestions, but Naturebook never auto-posts or auto-tags a scan for an Event.

sections.title: New
items: Every account now includes three Pro scans with no calendar expiry, while your separate daily Flash scan remains available.
Results and Settings show how many Pro scans remain. After the third usable Pro result, saved Pro results stay fully viewable and you can upgrade for new Pro-only actions.

sections.title: Improved
items: Ordinary single-photo, standalone-audio, and description scans can continue with the daily Flash policy after the three included Pro scans are used. Video, multi-item, mixed, and other Pro-only analyses show the upgrade option.
Retries and recovery reuse the original analysis, so a temporary or proven terminal failure cannot spend an extra Pro scan. Paid subscriptions and the paid 7 Day Pass are unchanged.

sections.title: Improved
items: Every account now starts in Backyard Safari Level 1, so its first goals are ready in Scan without a separate enrollment step.
Active Backyard Safari status may appear on your public author profile, but enrollment never publishes its scans, media, notes, or location evidence.
Backyard Safari and Park Pollinators now start with 2 goals, expand to 4 in Level 2, and finish with a new Level 3 while keeping valid credited scans.
Backyard Safari now begins with Bird and Dog, and Dog requires an exact domestic-dog identification.
All six collectible level patches have refreshed embroidered artwork reflecting each level’s updated discoveries.

sections.title: New
items: Save to camera roll can now automatically preserve new camera photos and original-quality video recordings in Photos.
Download scan and batch Download now save retained videos alongside photos, with clear counts and failure feedback.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video observations whose original clip is no longer available now show one retained photo instead of a black video page. If no original photo or video remains, the media carousel ends with a clear unavailable-photo message.

sections.title: Improved
items: Field trip goals now count an AI identification only when it is at least a Possible match for your scan tier. A Weak match stays pending until you confirm or correct it, so uncertain identifications no longer complete goals automatically.

entries.title: Reliable scans from capture to sharing

sections.title: Fixed
items: Completed scan analyses now finish saving before they appear, so the same observation is ready for your library, Field chat, and Explore sharing.
Video scans now complete with one playable clip and poster instead of being rejected or exposing sampled analysis frames as separate photos.

Offline image, audio, video, and description scans now keep their media and retry history until recovery really finishes, count partial-upload retries correctly, verify the exact completed media set, require the completed upload state to save before analysis starts, reject empty or damaged success responses, require every later local save and cleanup step to finish before completion, retain source media until durable cleanup even when no identification is found, record successful work as completed instead of cancelled, resume safely without analyzing an already-completed observation twice, no longer start overlapping recovery passes when the library and background services wake together, no longer get trapped endlessly re-uploading after a retryable cloud save failure even when an upgraded local store exposes temporarily out-of-sync retry state, and can start a fresh automatic recovery window when you explicitly retry after a safety pause.

Damaged legacy queue entries now pause visibly for attention without continuously polling the library or hiding newer valid scans, offline or network-blocked rows stay visible without producing a library refresh loop, and upload signing rejects empty image, audio, and video files.

A queued scan that completes while it is open now replaces the scanning view with its saved analysis without reverting to a stale queued screen, keeps playable audio attached, and restores Field chat, Share, and Field notes without requiring you to reopen it.

Queued scans now respond when Low Data Mode or cellular changes back to an eligible Wi-Fi path even if the phone never appeared offline, while the library, video uploader, automatic analysis preparation, status checks, and retry callbacks recheck the latest network policy before network work, release interrupted claims without spending retry attempts, start every signed file for one scan together or not at all, and prevent a non-forced mixed-media video scan from partially continuing from Wi-Fi over cellular.

Deleting an observation now remains safely queued and keeps retrying until cloud erasure is explicitly confirmed, including when sign-in, connection, server responses, or several app wakeups happen together.

Eligible older observations can recover a missing cloud record when you open Field chat, including when an earlier cloud media repair was abandoned, and can reliably restore surviving local media after analysis has completed when you deliberately share to Explore or Ask the Community; switching observations cannot mix the prior scan's private chat or draft, sharing and editor sheets, field notes, collection, identification, deletion, or offline-queue recovery state into the newly opened scan.
An older observation whose missing cloud record contradicts an obsolete on-device Explore marker now returns to Share, allowing secure recovery instead of leaving you on a broken Edit action.

Field chat now stays available to retry while an observation is still syncing, safely coordinates simultaneous sends across devices, keeps shared daily and conversation limits consistent between Insight and Explore, keeps one question and answer together through interrupted, automatic, and manual retries instead of sending a duplicate, recovers a long-interrupted unanswered request without duplicating the saved question, restores an unanswered question to Retry and Edit after relaunch instead of showing it as delivered, rejects incomplete, mismatched, or oversized saved replies before replacing your private thread or removing a failed question, and no longer mistakes educational diet, foraging, or hazard questions for unsafe instructions.

Private Field chat conversations, messages, and feedback are now database-bound to one exact observation or Explore post and viewer, so a damaged historical row cannot mix subjects or break an otherwise valid thread.

A failed Explore share now keeps your post draft open so you can retry without re-entering your notes, hashtags, location choice, or media selection, an interrupted save cannot replace an existing complete post with a partial one, stale or partial share-state responses cannot create a phantom post, media-recovery state no longer appears as a visible Explore destination, and older empty media-alert responses no longer produce a false library error.

Ask the Community now saves the observation and identification request together, so an interrupted request cannot accidentally publish a normal Explore post; recovery keeps surviving image, video, and audio media, an incomplete response is rejected, and an unconfirmed response no longer shows a false success.

sections.title: Improved
items: AI-backed scans and chat now use server-verified plan limits and retry-safe request handling, keeping access consistent across devices and temporary network failures.

sections.title: New
items: Species Dictionary pages can now be shared with readable links. A link opens the matching page in Naturebook when installed or a rich public reference page in the browser.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Your scan's own photo now appears only once in Insight and Explore post galleries, while other Naturebook observations and eligible reference images remain available.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Closing Field notes without making changes no longer shows a visibility message or refreshes the Explore post.
Edited notes still save automatically, with clear feedback that distinguishes text updates from public or private visibility changes.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Audio playheads in Explore feed, Explore post detail, and completed scan Insights now move smoothly with audible playback and stay put while paused, buffering, or seeking.
The first playback of boosted Insight audio now waits for a safe source handoff and falls back to the original recording if decoding stops unexpectedly, instead of freezing or jumping to the end.

sections.title: New
items: Turn on Open Explore on launch in Settings to begin a fresh Naturebook session in Explore. Shared photos, links, and notifications still open where you expect.

sections.title: Improved
items: Capture settings are now called Workspace, keeping Camera, Audio, Reorder modes, Field trip goal, and submission controls together.

sections.title: Improved
items: Field trip detail now uses Goals and Tips tabs, calls the primary action Start outing, and shows a larger circular progress ring on the active level.
Completed goals now show the exact captured photo or video thumbnail in outing cards and detail; tapping one opens that Insight inside the current Explore sheet with a back arrow.
Outing detail now shows a left-aligned Private badge above the title until you publish a public snapshot, then changes it to Published.

sections.title: Improved
items: Domestic cat and dog identifications now hide third-party reference images in Insight and shared Explore pages while keeping your captured media and retaining galleries for wild species.

sections.title: New name, same library
items: Merian is now Naturebook. The name is new; your scans, account, subscriptions, and Explore content stay exactly where they are.

sections.title: New
items: Filter the Explore feed by species, image/audio/video media, shared date, and Nearby distance from one sheet.

sections.title: New
items: Share a photo from Photos directly to Naturebook for identification.

sections.title: Improved
items: Live-camera still-image analysis now starts sooner, avoids competing duplicate uploads and analysis requests, and shows the saved identification before optional follow-up work finishes. Analysis quality and plan-specific AI models are unchanged.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Scan results now reveal the identification, carousel state, and completion feedback together while optional reference details continue loading in the background.

sections.title: Improved
items: Still-image scans now replace the full-image laser sweep with fast native subject brackets, a dimmed exterior, and a subtle scanning highlight contained inside the focus area.
Broad or ambiguous scenes show no fallback box and retain the full-image scan animation; focused and full-image scans never appear together.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Audio recording now waits for the camera to release capture hardware when switching modes, preventing false hardware-unavailable errors during a fast Camera-to-Audio transition.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Reporting an Explore post now enters the public-content moderation queue without incorrectly flagging the underlying species identification for review.

sections.title: Improved
items: Public Explore post pages now present images, looping muted videos, audio spectrograms, and reference images in one square media carousel.
Public web audio posts now offer an optional Boost audio control that improves quiet playback locally without changing the published recording.
The public discovery grid now uses species reference photos for audio posts while post details retain the playable spectrogram.
Public post details now center Report this post below the Taxonomy card and omit like and comment counts.

sections.title: New
items: Shared Explore post pages now autoplay videos muted on a continuous loop while their carousel slide is selected, with familiar browser controls.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Videos in Scans, Insights, and Explore now reactivate sound when playback starts or is unmuted, without requiring an audio post to be played first.

sections.title: Improved
items: Fullscreen Insight videos now use streamlined custom play or pause and mute controls, while carousel dots stay in their standard gallery position.
Fullscreen Insight videos now begin playing immediately and preserve the sound setting selected in the Insight carousel.
Insight videos now loop continuously while selected in both the sheet carousel and fullscreen viewer.
The center of an Insight video now safely plays or pauses without opening the fullscreen media viewer; tapping elsewhere still opens the gallery.
Insight-sheet videos now pause before the fullscreen media carousel opens, preventing sound from continuing underneath the viewer.
Insight-sheet videos now use streamlined custom playback chrome without skip controls or a progress bar, while retaining center play or pause and mute controls.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Reanalyze species now remains available after candidate review for cloud-backed and multi-image scans and opens the reanalysis flow after the review sheet closes.

sections.title: Improved
items: Audio posts now show their playable recording spectrogram on the public Naturebook web post page instead of a generic speaker placeholder.

sections.title: New
items: Explore map results can now be filtered by images, videos, or audio alongside species groups.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Collection thumbnails now use another scan when the selected cover's visuals have been archived.

sections.title: Improved
items: Audio posts in profile and compact Explore grids now keep the species reference photo and show a waveform badge instead of reverting to a generic image placeholder.
Audio scans in the Scans library now use the species reference photo with a waveform badge; opening the scan still shows the spectrogram and playback controls.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Image loading no longer blocks user-initiated threads while waiting for decode capacity, reducing hang risk during fast scrolling and media-heavy screens.
Decode concurrency remains bounded to protect memory on large libraries and high-resolution media.

sections.title: Improved
items: Explore feed videos now resume muted so sound does not continue unexpectedly in the background.
Opening a video post carries your current mute choice into detail, while returning to the feed resets autoplay to muted.
The center Play or Pause control on feed audio and video now controls playback without opening the post; tapping elsewhere still opens detail.

sections.title: New
items: Standalone audio posts now offer an optional Boost audio setting in feed and detail menus for quiet recordings.
Completed scan-library Insights with audio now offer a separate per-scan Boost audio setting that applies to every audio clip in that scan.
Audio spectrograms can now seek by tap or drag in Explore post detail and completed scan Insights, while Explore feed gestures remain unchanged.
Playback, mute, audio boost, and seeking controls now provide consistent tactile feedback without vibrating during autoplay or continuous progress updates.
Each post remembers its own boost setting on this device, while the original shared recording remains unchanged.
Boosted playback preserves the playhead, restores saved settings quietly, shows a small Boosted audio badge on the spectrogram, and falls back to the original audio if boosting is unavailable.

sections.title: New
items: Standalone audio scans can now be selected and played in Explore posts.
Speech and non-speech sounds are checked for harmful content before an audio share succeeds, so rejected or unavailable checks create no public post.
Previously approved recordings can reuse a privacy-safe content decision when the recording and safety policy are unchanged.
Older audio scans can now be shared when their original recording is still available on this device.
Approved audio posts can play in Explore and on public web share pages; audio-only posts remain excluded from Home Screen widgets.
Deleting or automatically expiring a scan now removes its standalone audio from cloud storage.

sections.title: Improved
items: The Profile identity menu now includes an Edit profile picture action alongside name and username editing.
Profile names are now optional; clearing a custom name restores the public username as the author label across Profile and Explore.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Newly empty scan libraries now show the first-scan empty state instead of a blank screen, including after signing out.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Signing out now clears only the current simulator or device session, and RevenueCat customers carry Supabase/public identity details so support can match Test Store Pro status back to Naturebook accounts.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Startup recovery now repairs devices carrying the accidental optional-queue V48 store by migrating forward to V49, routes V42 stores directly to V49 instead of through the older V42-to-V43 bridge, routes V43-V47 stores through source-isolated V49 repair plans, archives legacy stores that still cannot migrate so Naturebook can rebuild a fresh persistent library, and TestFlight/debug safe-mode cards include redacted copy/share diagnostics.

sections.title: Added
items: The original Field trips preview introduced regional checklist quests that could auto-start from new scans, unlock levels sequentially, and appear on public profiles as checklist progress only.

Field trips now include guided detail pages, explicit Start, curated checklist tips, a Field trips-only Community segment with For You, Following, and Recent filters, and up to 3 pinned published trips on profiles.
Published Field trip pages show species snapshots with likes and comments without publishing the underlying scans to the Explore feed or map.
Field trip comments, replies, and followed-author publications can now appear in the in-app activity bell without sending push notifications.

sections.title: Improved
items: Explore Home Screen widgets now show video posts as clean still thumbnails without a play badge.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Opening an author profile from Explore feed, post detail, or comments now stays inside the Explore navigation stack instead of layering a profile sheet over the active video surface, with profile-to-scan navigation capped so users cannot build an endlessly nested stack.

sections.title: Improved
items: Pro video recordings now use native iOS stabilization when available, and Naturebook resets the camera connection afterward so still photos keep their normal resolution and latency.

sections.title: Improved
items: Product analytics now use PostHog across app events, session funnels, and backend events, with clearer client event names for scan completion, queueing, thermal throttling, errors, and species dictionary page loads.

sections.title: Improved
items: Audio recordings now show denser, smoother spectrograms while recording, reviewing staged audio, and playing back Insight audio.

sections.title: Improved
items: Photo-library scans, reanalysis images, and profile avatar previews now use stricter image-size limits before staging, reducing memory pressure when very large photos are selected.

sections.title: Improved
items: Species dictionary records now queue missing public reference details for scheduled enrichment, helping sparse pages gain Wikipedia, GBIF, reference image, habitat, lookalike, and group-tag coverage over time.

sections.title: Added
items: Field chat now offers Review alternatives and Reanalyze species actions when your follow-up wording suggests the current ID is wrong, uncertain, a different species, mismatched to visible traits, or worth checking again.

sections.title: Improved
items: Staged video previews can now be dismissed with a downward swipe before submitting the scan for analysis.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video scan media now loops during active analysis so the scanning overlay keeps moving over playback until results arrive.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video captures now clean up temporary playback and audio files when canceled or rejected, and analysis waits until queued media is safely saved.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Queued scan retry now gives visible feedback, refreshes the open Insight sheet, and leaves cancellation to the existing top-right trash control.

Automatic offline retries now use jittered backoff and pause for attention after repeated scan upload, analysis, cloud-deletion, or collection-sync failures, while repeated server replay failures turn terminal instead of retrying indefinitely.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Explore video posts now autoplay when opened, fill their square preview, use a centered play/pause control that fades during playback, and keep mute or sound-on state synced across videos.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Processed materials such as wool rugs, leather goods, wooden furniture, paper, textiles, prepared food, toys, and artwork now stay out of the species dictionary even when they are made from biological material.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Empty Field notes cards now hide Published and Private badges until notes have been saved.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video scan uploads now allow five sampled inference frames plus the playback clip in one staging batch, and staged media rows can be created before the final scan record exists.
Video scan upload signing now works on production tables that still required a public media URL before staged uploads were promoted.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Network timeout results now keep sentence-case wording, explain automatic retry, and no longer show non-biological collection or retention messaging.

sections.title: Improved
items: Queued image, video, audio, and description scans now keep retry state across app restarts, show clearer retry or needs-attention status, and preserve user media during transient failures.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Recent TestFlight upgrades now reopen existing local scan libraries normally instead of launching in safe mode after a schema update.
Startup schema migration now skips a no-op historical schema stage that could make SwiftData reject the migration plan before opening the local library.
Local libraries blocked by duplicate schema checksums now retry startup with short, recent-only migration plans before legacy rescue or safe mode.
Fresh and already-current local libraries now open without validating the full historical migration plan, while recent older libraries use the smallest source-specific plan available.
Offline-queue schema upgrades now initialize durable retry state for existing queued scans instead of repeatedly reopening in safe mode.
V47 queued-media library upgrades now snapshot and recreate queued scans with durable retry metadata, avoiding a SwiftData startup crash during upgrade checks.
Startup safe mode now reports local library upgrade failures more clearly while keeping the existing store in place.

sections.title: Improved
items: Upgrade safety checks now cover queued image, video, audio, description, and mixed-media scans together before release.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video scans now require a saved playback clip before completing, and Explore sharing can repair missing cloud video media when the local clip is still available.

sections.title: Improved
items: Cloud video scans now keep ready-state media records for future sharing and playback recovery.
Scan media uploads now carry server-tracked lifecycle state before final scan persistence.
Staged video uploads can now be reconciled automatically when a cloud scan needs media repair.
Video scan processing now records server-side progress so retry and recovery paths can tell whether a scan is processing, finalizing, or needs another attempt.
Server recovery now verifies the exact media manifest for a scan before completing repair or abandoning staged uploads.
Server recovery now keeps a sanitized replay intent for staged scan uploads without storing raw media bytes.
Server recovery can now retry resumable staged scan uploads automatically when the app exits or a transient backend failure interrupts finalization.
Server recovery now tracks image, description, and audio compatibility scan submissions in the same ingestion ledger before reporting success.
Scan media reliability checks now cover image, video, audio, description, replay, repair, and Explore sharing contracts together before backend deploys.
Scan media health reports now include clearer incident guidance when production recovery needs attention.
Queued video scans now wait for server finalization instead of retrying too early when the app resumes mid-save.

sections.title: Improved
items: Human identifications now hide reference images in Insight and shared Explore pages so only the user's captured media is shown.

sections.title: Improved
items: Video scan media now starts muted playback when its Insight sheet opens, with a bottom-left sound status toggle.
Account-library video scans whose cloud record still listed sampled frames now open the playable video instead of a thumbnail sequence.
Video scans that only have sampled frames available now fall back to the middle frame instead of filling the Insight carousel with all five samples.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Video clips selected in the Explore composer now publish, edit, and request Community ID correctly from the server media source list, and failed media snapshots no longer make the Share sheet look like a post already exists.

sections.title: Changed
items: Built-in collection tiles now appear below the main Collections content so first-collection guidance appears before Favorites and Non-biological.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Live viewfinder hint pills now hide once single-scan content is staged or multi-scan staging is full.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The Pro paywall purchase button now stays anchored to the bottom of the sheet.

sections.title: Improved
items: Dog and cat Insight headers now keep the taxonomy subtitle focused on the scientific name when a breed, mix, coat, or body-type label is shown as the headline.

sections.title: Improved
items: Shared field notes now show Published or Private badges, and their Explore visibility can be changed directly from the Field notes edit sheet.

sections.title: Added
items: Published scans now show Explore post actions in the Insight top menu, with quick access to edit or view the post and any existing community request.

sections.title: Added
items: Profile and Settings now include a Share Naturebook action with a working website destination before the App Store listing goes live.

sections.title: Improved
items: Insight now uses a richer bottom milestone banner when a scan adds a species to Naturebook's shared species dictionary.
Achievement unlock banners now avoid stacking with foreground iOS notifications.
Older domestic cat and dog scans can unlock the new achievements silently without showing surprise retroactive banners.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Fixed a crash that could happen after tapping stop on a Pro video recording while Naturebook extracted the clip's audio.
Upload-safe Pro video clips now still stage when playback compression is slow or unavailable.
Video scans now keep identifying when optional video audio is unusable, and background retry keeps the staged video clip attached.

sections.title: Improved
items: Saved Pro video clips now prefer compression for lighter scan-library playback, Explore sharing, and cloud storage while AI analysis still samples frames from the original recording.
Cloud-hydrated video scans now keep sampled analysis frames hidden behind the playable video instead of showing them as standalone Insight carousel images.

sections.title: Added
items: Audio recordings now submit automatically when they reach the full time limit and confirm-before-submit is turned off.

sections.title: Improved
items: The Pro paywall now features video scans in the carousel and gives feature descriptions more room to wrap cleanly.

sections.title: Added
items: Pro video scans now show a countdown while recording, include an X cancel control before staging, and open staged clips in a full-screen preview where they can be removed before identifying.

sections.title: Added
items: Profile now has cat and dog scan achievements that unlock when you document your first domestic cat or dog.
Public Explore author profile sheets now include the cat and dog achievements too.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Achievement cards now refresh immediately when the scan that completed them is deleted from the achievement detail flow.

sections.title: Improved
items: Video scan analysis now samples five ordered frames, treats accompanying audio as evidence from the same video, and no longer describes video scans as images.

sections.title: Improved
items: Photo captures and video recording starts now use a stronger, prewarmed haptic cue, and video recording begins almost immediately after a brief hold.

sections.title: Added
items: Non-biological Insight results now show a clear pill plus a notice explaining their 30-day retention, while hiding biological-only field notes, tags, and collection actions.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Launch recovery now handles damaged local scan libraries more safely without signing you out.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-biological captures that omit ecology metadata now save with an unknown ecology fallback instead of failing in the backend.

sections.title: Added
items: Shared video scans can now appear in Explore and Ask the Community, with muted playback in feed/detail and in-app thumbnail play indicators on compact surfaces.

sections.title: Added
items: Pro users can now briefly hold the visual shutter to record a short video scan, with saved playback and image-based thumbnails.
Video recording now gives clearer haptic feedback when recording starts, finishes, stages successfully, or fails.
Video scan analysis treats five sampled frames and accompanying audio as evidence from the same video.
Video scan media now opens from the Insight carousel into fullscreen playback.
Video scans now open as the saved clip in Insight while scan tiles and previews keep using the poster thumbnail.
The Pro paywall comparison table now includes video scans.
Scans filters now include Image and Video media filters.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-Pro long-presses keep the normal photo-first shutter behavior and do not open the paywall.
Pending video scans can now resolve the saved local clip immediately after submission.

sections.title: Added
items: Insight overviews now present invasive status as a compact, location-aware summary with the assessed region, confidence, and Naturebook's rationale when available.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The confidence details sheet now hides the upgrade plan card for Pro users.

sections.title: Changed
items: Field chat message text is now larger so questions and answers are easier to read.

sections.title: Added
items: Your own Explore post menus now include View insight, including posts opened from an Insight sheet or your Profile's published scans.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Notification-opened comment reply threads now include the same emoji reaction controls as regular Explore comments.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Overview interactions now wrap fully instead of truncating longer ecological interaction notes.

sections.title: Changed
items: Pro plan cards now match the current paywall value props for high-volume field scans, Pro AI vision, AI chat, multi-capture, Apple Watch logging, and expedition mode.

sections.title: Changed
items: Pro plan cards now use the intended launch prices and labels for Annual and the 7 Day Pass, even while App Store product metadata is settling.
AI chat now appears in the Pro paywall feature comparison table.

sections.title: Added
items: Scans now has a full filter sheet for sorting, category, dates, location, tags, naturalist details, photo quality, identification state, weather, season, and taxonomy.
The Scans filter sheet now includes an Explore posts filter for scans that have already been shared to Explore.
Scans filters now stack with search and sorting, with a visible active-filter count and a clear action that keeps the current search text.
The Scans and Collections active-filter badge is now red so it stands out from the blue filter button.

sections.title: Changed
items: Collections now starts with a taller full-width Featured scans collection that uses a daily rotating set of up to 24 scans from your library.
Favorites, Needs review, and Non-biological now appear as gallery-style artwork collection tiles.
Collections now has a Scans-style filter sheet with sorting plus User-created, Smart suggestions, and Built-in collection type filters.
Collection creation now lives in a blue plus button in the Collections toolbar, the unused Collections sort menu has been removed, and Needs review stays pinned instead of being hideable.

sections.title: Changed
items: Explore post shares now use clearer Naturebook copy before the public web preview link.
Explore post web links now open the matching native Explore post when Naturebook is installed.

sections.title: Improved
items: Species seasonality charts now use one unified month heatmap with represented totals, peak month detail, and a clearer unavailable state while buckets refresh.

sections.title: Added
items: Biological Insight sheets now open Field chat from the bottom toolbar as a dedicated sheet with one saved conversation per scan.
Add to collection now lives in the Insight header menu below field notes, keeping the bottom toolbar focused on sharing and chat.
Field chat answers now use richer private scan context, including observed traits, ecology metadata, review state, and capture-quality signals.
Field chat now supports offline read-only viewing, failed-send retry and edit, safety guidance headers, answer feedback, and append-only field-notes actions.
The Field chat toolbar button now has a subtle steady rainbow glow so the AI entry point is easier to notice without moving or restyling the native button label.
Field notes cards now show more of your notes before truncating longer entries.
Field chat summaries now use readable observation labels instead of internal scan IDs.
Field chat answer actions are now focused on icon-only copy and inline feedback, with summaries and feature feedback in the sheet options menu.
Field chat sheet feedback is now saved privately with the scan instead of being telemetry-only.
Field chat quick prompts now refresh with AI-generated, scan-specific follow-up ideas based on the saved observation and recent chat.
Field chat now checks scan availability before opening so scans owned by another signed-in account show a clear unavailable state instead of launching into a chat error.

sections.title: Added
items: Insight images now open into a full-screen, fit-centered carousel with swipe navigation, zoom, and reference attribution.
Species Dictionary reference galleries now open into the same full-screen image viewer.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Profile signed-out spacing below the sign-in buttons now matches the gap between the stat cards.
Describe suggestions now keep the bottom toolbar available after you tap a prompt chip.
The Describe add button now uses a secondary outline state when the input is empty and the filled active state once text is present.
Profile published-scan grids now keep rounded outer image corners on partial rows instead of exposing sharp edges.
The full-screen Insight image viewer now closes with a downward swipe.
Full-screen Insight images now stay vertically centered in the viewer.
Collections now has a little more top spacing so the first cards sit more comfortably below the Scans toolbar.
Explore Index Catalog scrolling now keeps the grouped gray background behind the full page instead of ending partway down the catalog.

entries.title: Dictionary, taxonomy tree, and layout updates

sections.title: Changed
items: Ask the Community search can now find GBIF-backed taxa that are not yet enriched in Naturebook's Dictionary.
Newly materialized Dictionary species can now hydrate habitat, lookalikes, and group tags in the background.
Naturebook's Community ID taxonomy and enrichment systems now have stronger backend monitoring for rollout health.
Naturebook can now safely seed bird taxonomy coverage in the background for future Dictionary completeness progress.
Smart Collection cards now use varied matching scan covers, except Recent finds, instead of always reusing the newest scan thumbnail.
Dog and cat scans can now show a likely breed, mix, coat pattern, or body type while Naturebook keeps the underlying species taxonomy unchanged.
The main camera tab bar now matches the Explore bottom navigation icon size, label size, and item spacing.
Identify requests now have organism filters for Plants, Birds, Insects, Fungi, Mammals, and Herps while keeping Yours near the start of the filter row.

Community request details now frame the starting name as Naturebook's AI identification with the stored scan model tier, an optional confidence pill, and collapsed reasoning, while the ID count lives with the Identifications section.
Explore Tree now opens in a top-down taxonomy layout instead of the earlier sideways orientation.
Explore Dictionary and Tree controls now provide haptic feedback on button actions.
Explore Tree now has All species and My scans filter pills so you can switch between Naturebook's public taxonomy and your scanned-species tree.
Explore Dictionary cards, rows, thumbnails, loading skeletons, and the featured Recently Added card now use the softer rounded corners and roomier image-first layout from Identify request surfaces.
Explore Dictionary Catalog now opens directly into the browse overview without a top-level search bar, while subcategory catalog pages keep their own search.
The Explore Dictionary Recently Added feature card now opens that species' dictionary page, while a separate Recently Added row opens the full newest species list.
Explore Dictionary previews now prefer promoted Naturebook community photos over external reference images when available.
Notifications settings now include a single action to turn off every Naturebook notification category at once.
Open Identify request cards and loading skeletons now hide AI-derived names and show only the scan image with a compact submitted-ID count overlay.
You can now choose a public profile picture, display name, and username before signing in, and those choices carry into Apple or Google sign-in.
Profile now starts with identity and stats, followed by published scans, the non-Pro plan card, persona progress, the scan heatmap, and achievements.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Publishing a resolved Ask the Community request now applies the owner-approved species consensus to the scan and prepares new GBIF-backed species for Dictionary enrichment.
Ask the Community requests now stay associated with your signed-in account after identity changes, so they remain visible under Yours.
Explore Dictionary Recently Added now shows the newest-entry count instead of matching the full All species total.
Insight sharing and Ask the community requests now recover when a local scan is missing its cloud scan row.
The Ask the community request sheet now keeps Send and Save in the sheet toolbar so create and edit requests use the same form style.
The proactive beta feedback survey now waits until the Insight sheet closes before appearing after your third scan.
Identify request cards now refresh their submitted-ID badge after you suggest, withdraw, or restore an ID from the request detail screen.
Existing Ask the community requests now show Edit and View actions in the Insight share flow, plus a Publish to Explore option with a visible review disclaimer.
Explore feed hashtag rows now scroll edge to edge without being clipped by card padding.
The Explore edit-post sheet now keeps its Save footer compact instead of expanding up the screen.
Explore Map now keeps the active selected waypoint above overlapping nearby waypoints.
Explore Map bottom controls now stay anchored near the tab bar when switching from Feed to Map.
Identify now returns from community request details without flashing the generic Explore title in the header.
Explore profile pages now load with skeleton placeholders instead of a simple spinner.
The Pro paywall hero carousel no longer clips the image glow into a hard top edge.
The Insight share sheet now uses the Identify artwork, updated Ask the Community action icons, and clearer helper and confirmation copy.
Explore Tree zoom controls no longer jump upward when selecting a taxonomy node.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore Map now has horizontal species-type filter pills for the current region.
The first filter pill opens a detailed filter sheet for selecting map species types.
Map filters now use backend category counts so visible clusters and discoveries match the active species filters.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore now has an Identify tab for Ask the Community identification requests.
Biological insights can request community help with optional notes and post-level location sharing.
The Community Suggest ID sheet now opens with AI-derived starting suggestions when available.
Identify now has Requests and Activity modes in the header, plus an All/Yours request filter.
Your own Community requests now have an options menu for editing the request note and location sharing.
Community requests from other explorers now have a report action in the options menu.
Community request detail images now extend into the top edge of the sheet, matching Insight image presentation.
Community requests now load with skeleton cards instead of a spinner.
Explore error states now use the same unavailable layout and Retry action style as Dictionary.
Community identification notifications now cover new IDs, resolved requests, and helped consensus outcomes, with a dedicated Profile push preference.
Ask the Community confirmations now include a View action that opens the new request directly.
When all identification candidates are rejected, Ask the Community is now offered as the next step.
Community request details include consensus status, an identification timeline, taxonomy search, disagreement prompts, and withdraw/restore actions.

sections.title: Changed
items: Community identification now uses versioned taxonomy, queued consensus processing, and verified Explore graduation behind the scenes.
Low-confidence Insight shares now default to asking Identify for help, while direct Explore publishing remains available behind a confirmation.
Resolved Identify requests now stay out of normal Explore until the owner explicitly publishes them.
Explore hashtag pills now use transparent backgrounds, gray borders, and blue text on feed cards, post detail pages, and the post composer.
The unused identification-review action has been removed from Insight and candidate review flows.
Community identification sheets now use icon close controls and a cleaner disagreement reason field.
Community identification timelines now hide internal consensus labels from user-facing copy.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore Dictionary now has a header control for switching between the Catalog and taxonomy Tree views.
The Explore bottom menu stays focused on Observations, Identify, and Dictionary while Feed/Map and Catalog/Tree live in header controls.
The Tree view now opens directly into the pan-and-zoom taxonomy canvas without its own search field or filled top heading background.
The Tree zoom and locate controls now use liquid-glass circular buttons.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Species Dictionary catalog and overview surfaces now filter out non-biological encyclopedia rows before they can appear as dictionary records.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Profiles with no scans now still show the empty contribution cells in the scan heatmap instead of a collapsed grid.

sections.title: Added
items: A one-time beta feedback survey now asks how Naturebook is working for testers after meaningful use.
You can also open the survey from Settings in the Resources section.
Survey responses are saved privately so the team can review polish, performance, bugs, and feature requests.
After submitting, the thank-you state resets after 24 hours so you can send fresh feedback again from Settings.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore now has bottom navigation for Observations, Identify, and Dictionary.
Observations now has a header control for switching between Feed and Map, with Feed first.

Dictionary opens with a Recently Added featured species card, a full-width Your Region map card when local entries are available, an All row, plus region rows for browsing local range metadata. Region browsing stays hidden when no region records are available.
Your Region can use already-granted location access for a better local match, while falling back to the device locale without a Dictionary-specific permission prompt.
Dictionary also includes custom graphic browse cards for broad groups like Plants, Birds, Insects, Fungi, Mammals, and Reptiles & Amphibians, with toolbar search available inside those species lists.

entries.title: Scan durability, reanalysis, and geoprivacy fixes

sections.title: Changed
items: Candidate review prompts now appear only for non-strong identifications or strong IDs with a competitive alternative, while stored candidates remain available for recovery and future review flows. The Needs review smart collection follows the same non-strong and competitive-alternative thresholds.
Biological scan images are now durable for Free and Pro users; Naturebook no longer auto-purges successful sighting evidence based on age or tier.
Species dictionary galleries can now include more published Naturebook photos while still requiring strong species confidence.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-biological corrections now explain what happened and start reanalysis instead of creating an unidentified biological scan with incorrect confidence, phantom reference media, or early Explore sharing.
Non-biological results now show the clearer title "Non-biological" instead of unresolved taxonomy placeholder text.
Correction reanalysis from the Non-biological collection remains available to free users while still following normal daily scan limits when submitted.
The reanalysis explanation no longer stays in the Describe text field as if it were user-entered notes.
Describe notes entered for the current reanalysis are now included with the submission and cleared from the input afterward.
Explore Map now shows only open-location discoveries, keeping obscured and private posts off the map.
Explore share and edit options now include per-post geoprivacy, so a post can be private, obscured, or explicitly open without changing the underlying scan default.

sections.title: Added
items: 7-day Pro passes now use verified RevenueCat purchases with a Naturebook-owned expiration window so access ends reliably after the pass period.

sections.title: Improved
items: The Pro paywall now has a richer visual flow with selectable plan cards, plan comparisons, member-supported context, and a persistent purchase button.
Restore purchases, redeem code, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use actions are easier to find from the paywall.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore comments now support @username mentions for post authors, visible thread participants, and people you follow.
Mentioned users can receive Explore activity notifications without turning the comment into a reply.

sections.title: Improved
items: The comment composer can suggest eligible handles as you type, and tapped mentions open that user's public Explore profile.
Notification settings now include an independent push toggle for Explore comment mentions.
Explore activity and comment mention push notifications now default on for new installs.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The comment mention push toggle now stays independent from the separate Explore activity push setting.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Needs review now follows the shared non-strong and competitive-alternative thresholds instead of including every scan with alternate candidates.

sections.title: Added
items: Explore sharing and editing now lets you choose which known common name appears on the community post.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Shared Explore posts now keep the selected common name instead of drifting to dictionary defaults.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Non-biological scans older than 30 days are now cleaned up locally when the app returns to the foreground or when you open the Non-biological collection.

sections.title: Added
items: Collections can now suggest useful groups from your scan library, including recent finds, places, review candidates, Explore posts, and common organism groups.
Smart collections update automatically from your library and can be hidden locally.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Private scans now hide location details across scan cards, sharing, achievements, and Messages share captions.
Open and obscured scans now restore location context at the expected precision.

entries.title: Explore post details and dictionary improvements

sections.title: Improved
items: Explore post details now keep deeper species education in the species dictionary, with a direct link from each post.
Reference images, observation context, and alternate common names are arranged more clearly around the post's AI explanation.
Species dictionary pages can now load for species you have not discovered yet.
Explore posts now use usernames on feed cards and post detail headers.
The changelog now shows dates without version labels while release versioning is still being finalized.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Similar species suggestions now load reliably in insight sheets.

sections.title: Improved
items: Species observation charts now show public totals, seasonality, and history more quickly on first load.
Detailed life-stage and sex buckets refresh in the background so slow public data does not block the whole chart.

entries.title: Custom profile pictures, metadata, and sharing improvements

sections.title: Added
items: A new Settings changelog collects selected release notes, feature notes, and in-progress work inside the app.
Native Messages extension groundwork for sharing cached scan images, cards, and descriptions.
Logged-in users can upload custom public profile pictures, with Explore/Profile identity refresh.
AI-derived sex observation metadata on scan records, the Overview card, Supabase persistence, and Darwin Core exports.

sections.title: Improved
items: Field notes dictation startup feels steadier, and the loading spinner no longer shifts the button label.
Capture bottom controls stay visible after leaving Describe or canceling staged input.
Audio insight carousel swiping remains responsive when reference images load after the audio page is already visible.

sections.title: Added
items: Initial web app scaffold for public Explore share pages.
Public Terms, Privacy Policy, Community Guidelines, Privacy Choices, Support, and Legal hub pages for naturebook.earth.
An iOS-to-web theme bridge so Naturebook-opened web pages can follow your app theme preference.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Explore map count text now says exactly one visible item is one discovery in view.
Scan purge jobs no longer risk deleting durable public avatar images.
